description: Verify that the L4 Protocol field of the IPv4 Endpoint Option (TCP) is 0x06 (TCP) (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Endpoint Option (TCP): L4 Protocol == 0x06 (TCP).

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's L4 Protocol field == 0x06 (TCP).   ← key check

[Pass condition]
L4 Protocol on the wire equals 0x06 (TCP).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_l4_tcp — No IPv4 endpoint option with TCP L4 or port mismatch
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Pass: IPv4 Endpoint Option (TCP) L4 Protocol = 0x06 (TCP) — normal
verdicts.Fail_l4_tcp: No IPv4 endpoint option with TCP L4 or port mismatch
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
